text:
Generate the NEXT FOUR complete run-start sprites, frames04-07, in a regular2x2 sheet read row-major. The newly uploaded single finished sprite is the PREVIOUS frame03: preserve its exact character size, outfit, face, spiky hair, boot proportions, camera and polished cel shading. The new schematic defines the four next joint/weapon poses only; DO NOT copy its labels, lines, colors, ground or construction shapes. Render finished Sora and Kingdom Key alone on white, no text or grid, equal square cells, whole weapon/body and safe margins. No layers.




Continue smoothly from frame03, not a new random pose. The FAR hand stays inside the same gold guard throughout. The near hand remains empty and gradually moves forward from beside the guard, with a bent elbow; do not jump instantly to an extended arm. Feet remain in the anticipation/weight-shift stance until the rear heel begins rising. No airborne stride yet. Follow guide hips, shoulders and hands with genuine anatomical changes, constant body/head size and common implied ground.




04: far grip rises slightly from previous03; rigid blade goes from up-left to nearly vertical on the back/left side, not across the face.

05: grip lifts farther toward the far/back shoulder; the WHOLE rigid weapon rotates through an upper-right diagonal overhead/behind the head, near hand low/empty and beginning its counter-swing.

06: far guard/hand approach the rear shoulder; shaft angles up-right BEHIND the head, which hides the middle of the continuous shaft. Near arm gradually bends forward; rear heel starts lifting.

07: settle into the FAR-ARM carry like the KHIV photo: guard/grip on screen-left by the BACK shoulder, silver shaft over THAT shoulder and behind hair/head toward screen-right, head occluding it, near hand empty in front, feet preparing to push off.




Match the diagram's red far-hand grip and straight weapon axis in each cell, but draw the full correct Kingdom Key with gold guard, black grip, blue collar, silver shaft and consistent rounded crown cutouts. Constant physical weapon length and guard shape, one connected handle/collar/shaft axis, chain at pommel. Never omit the shaft, detach blade/guard or swap to the near arm. Final blade tip points slightly toward the viewer. Preserve exactly two arms/hands and detailed shaded KH2 clothing in every cell. Produce the finished four images directly.
